title: The list shows Not Tracked right after Save, without a page reload
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NORELOAD-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, with 5 in {Bin-A}.
  • The part number of {Part-A} is typed in the Inventory search, so its row is the one shown.
custom_steps:
1. Click the {Part-A} row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is off.
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. Read the {Part-A} row.
  5. Click the {Part-A} row again and look at the switch.
  6. Click the switch so it is off.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Do not refresh the browser.
  9. Read the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The row still shows "5 Available": switching without saving changed nothing.
  • Step 5: The switch is on.
  • Step 9: The Total Qty cell already reads "Not Tracked"; the page did not reload (the search box still holds the part number and the list did not go blank or scroll to the top).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S5-R2, S5-R10, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 5.2 (Switch off) and 5.3 (The list says Not Tracked), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R2: “The change applies when the user saves the part.”
  • S5-R10: “After the save, the Total Qty column shows the new state without a page reload.”
